entry.title: New: dsh-hermes-memory
entry.summary: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost. Exact install spec: github:isheng-eqi/dsh-hermes-memory. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
